To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed three experimental models of brain irradiation in 10-day old mice: a model with whole brain irradiation and a targeted irradiation model of the dorsal and the ventral dentate gyri.

we developed three new mouse models of low to moderate dose brain irradiation, and we demonstrated that the ventral hippocampi are preferentially involved in the anxiety/depressive-like behavioral phenotype observed in these mice.
we have developed new experimental models of whole brain and targeted dentate gyrum irradiation in mice to study the effects of low to moderate IR exposure.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new experimental models in mice to study the consequences of brain exposure to low to moderate doses (<1 Gy) of IR.
the development and validation of a new experimental model to study the consequences of low and moderate doses of IR on brain functions and their related neurobiological mechanisms in mice.
the development of three new experimental models of brain and dentate gyrus exposure to low to moderate doses IR.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the ventral dentate plays a major role in mediating the behavioral effects of brain irradiation at low to moderate dose levels.
the ventral dentate is more sensitive to IR than the dorsal dentate.
the brain and the dentate gyrum are both sensitive to IR, and that the dentate gyrums are more sensitive than the brain.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ventral dentate plays a key role in the anxiety/depressive-like phenotype after brain and ventrale dentate irradiation in mice.
we have developed new mouse models of low to moderate dose brain irradiation, and that these new models have the capacity to help understand the mechanisms of IR exposure effects.
the ventral dentate is more sensitive than the dorsal dentate and the whole brain to the effects of low to moderate dose IR.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the brain is a complex organ with multiple functional substructures.
the brain is not a simple target, but rather a complex organ with distinct functional areas.
